items.title: ABHI UK HealthTech Conference 2026, London, 9 to 10 November
items.summary: ABHI's flagship two-day conference runs 9 to 10 November 2026 at the Cavendish Conference Centre, London. Day one covers regulation, MHRA early engagement, AI oversight and post-market surveillance.

items.title: HETT Show 2026, ExCeL London, 29 to 30 September
items.summary: HETT, Healthcare Excellence Through Technology, runs at ExCeL London on 29 and 30 September 2026. It draws NHS, local government and social care digital and clinical staff, with roughly 3,000 attendees, 250 speakers and 150 supplier exhibitors.

items.title: ABHI Digital Health Conference 2026, London, 7 October
items.summary: ABHI's Digital Health Conference takes place on Wednesday 7 October 2026, 09:30 to 18:30, at Covington and Burling LLP in London, covering digital health regulation, adoption and commercial routes for UK healthtech.

items.title: Government of Guernsey updates on progress and closure of EPR programme
items.summary: The Committee for Health and Social Care in Guernsey has shared updates on its EPR programme, highlighting outcomes from phase one and a decision to “transition towards closure” in favour of a rolling programme of improvement, requiring business justification and funding approval.

items.title: Barts Health continues to roll out ambient voice technology
items.summary: Barts Health NHS Trust is continuing to roll out ambient voice technology to capture clinic conversations and generate patient letters automatically, as part of a national trial.

items.title: NHS England on increased digital risk, pace of delivery for key digital programmes, vision for AI
items.summary: In its latest meeting, the NHS England board discussed upcoming programmes and priorities, including concerns about slow pace of delivery for key digital programmes such as the Federated Data Platform, increased cyber, tech and innovation risk, and the development of an IT system to support delivery of the NHS…

items.title: Initial HTN Now 2027 schedule launched: NHS Online Trust, EPRs, AVT, digital inclusion, workforce skills, neighbourhoods
items.summary: HTN is delighted to announce our initial HTN Now webinar schedule for 2027, where we will be sure to share digital and health tech projects, learnings, approaches and best practices across health and care! The webinars are FREE for NHS professionals – you can register your front row seat here.

items.title: National Data Guardian seeks views on single patient record
items.summary: The National Data Guardian (NDG) Nicola Byrne is seeking views from health and care professionals on the single patient record, with findings to be incorporated into a report published to the NDG website in Autumn 2026.

items.title: Calderdale and Huddersfield waitlist validation, Bradford reduces SMS costs, PIFU at County Durham and Darlington
items.summary: NHS England has updated on progress with digital referrals and appointments, noting evidence from Calderdale and Huddersfield to improve waitlist validation, a reduction in costs at Bradford Teaching Hospitals, and the go-live of patient initiated follow-up functionality using the NHS App at County Durham and…

items.title: HTN Now: How Enterprise Content Management can quickly and easily help your digital journey
items.summary: For a recent HTN Now webinar, we were joined by James Williams, diagnostic imaging and ECM specialist at Dedalus, to discuss how an Enterprise Content Management (ECM) strategy can support healthcare organisations in their journeys toward digital transformation.

items.title: East and West Midlands Ambulance Services collaboration agreement looks to emerging opportunities and next steps
items.summary: East Midlands Ambulance Service NHS Trust has outlined progress, emerging opportunities, and next steps from its digital collaboration agreement with West Midlands Ambulance Service.

items.title: Oracle launches Oracle Health Oncology EHR with AI assistant
items.summary: Oracle has introduced an oncology EHR, reportedly offering access to built-in AI agents and clinical decision support, intended to connect results, decision making, and action across the cancer care pathway.

items.title: Norfolk and Suffolk ICB notes significant outcomes with preventative interventions
items.summary: Norfolk and Suffolk ICB has published details of its digital weight management programme, highlighting the contribution of a population health management approach to achieving “significant” outcomes.

items.title: NHS England launches NHS-wide conversation on improving maternity and neonatal care
items.summary: NHS England has launched an NHS-wide conversation on improving maternity and neonatal care, inviting staff from across the system to have their say on improving services and making change.

items.title: EMIS rebrands as Enlivio Health
items.summary: EMIS has rebranded as Enlivio Health, announcing an “exciting new era” following a strategy refresh, the introduction of new leadership, and a renewed focus on improving pace and consistency across product and development teams.

items.title: What does the future of EPRs look like? Join us for HTN Now 30 September
items.summary: What does the future of EPRs look like? We’ll debate this question with a panel of experts 30 September as part of the HTN Now webinar series.

items.title: Wales opens innovation procurements to tackle missed appointments and modernise bowel screening pathways
items.summary: Innovation challenges across Wales have opened, looking to procure innovative solutions to reduce missed appointments and modernise bowel screening pathways under its Contracts for Innovation Cymru (CfIC) programme.

items.title: Leeds Community and Leeds and York Partnership share outcomes from AI pilot and work on digital inclusion
items.summary: Leeds Community Healthcare NHS Trust and Leeds and York Partnership NHS Foundation Trust has shared progress with its ambient voice tech pilot and its work focusing on digital inclusion.

items.title: UK Health Security Agency market engagement for tech supporting contact tracing, infection surveillance and response
items.summary: The UK Health Security Agency has opened a market engagement to understand capabilities in surveillance, infection identification, case management, and contact tracing during a UK health emergency.

items.title: CDIO appointed for new Online NHS Trust
items.summary: The Online NHS Trust has announced the appointment of the former CIO and executive director of Genomics England as its chief digital information officer.

items.title: AI Implementation Framework for Ireland outlines five phase approach for AI projects
items.summary: The Health Service Executive (HSE) for Ireland has published an AI implementation framework outlining a five phase approach for AI projects from identification and prioritisation through to deployment and ongoing monitor

items.title: Moorfields AI spinout Cascader completes seed funding round
items.summary: An AI spinout from Moorfields Eye Hospital NHS Foundation Trust has completed a seed round to help accelerate the translation of AI from research to clinical care. Cascader, a partnership between Moorfields, Topcon Healt

items.title: BMA warns practices against piloting ‘GP in your pocket’ AI tool
items.summary: The BMA has warned GP practices against getting involved in pilots of AI-assisted triage within the NHS App. The union said that expressions of interest have been going out to practices and PCNs to pilot AI technology which was announced in the 10-year health plan.

items.title: Royal Papworth Hospital and Cambridge University Hospital to share EPR
items.summary: Royal Papworth Hospital NHS Foundation Trust and Cambridge University Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust are to introduce a shared electronic patient record across the organisations. The partnership will see Cambridge Univer

items.title: NMC to develop principles for ‘safe and responsible’ AI use with other regulators
items.summary: The Nursing and Midwifery Council (NMC) is to help develop shared principles on artificial intelligence (AI) to ensure ‘safe and responsible’ use by healthcare professionals in the UK.

items.title: Scotland’s Programme for Government 2026-31: £10bn capital, £200m annually on elective capacity, AI hub, Hospital at Home expansion
items.summary: Scotland’s Programme for Government 2026-31 has been published, sharing government commitments to deliver a “stronger NHS”, including £10 billion in capital spending over the next decade, £200 million annually on electiv

items.title: FDA awards $1.2 million contract to test use of generative AI in assessing AI-radiology reports
items.summary: Cognita Imaging, a subsidiary of Mosaic Clinical Technologies, has been awarded a $1.2 million contract by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) to test a new approach for evaluating AI-generated radiology reports.

items.title: Medical Device Network analyses the battle for the community EPR in the UK
items.summary: Medical Device Network published analysis arguing that as more NHS care moves outside the hospital, the commercial importance of primary and community care IT and electronic patient records will increase.

items.title: Aneurin Bevan University Health Board and DHCW on data use, cloud, and dashboards
items.summary: Aneurin Bevan University Health Board (ABUHB) has shared an update on its use of data in clinical decision making, service planning, and performance improvement, noting the role of tech and digital skills in enabling sta

items.title: Royal Papworth to join Cambridge University Hospitals' Epic EPR via Epic Connect
items.summary: Royal Papworth Hospital NHS FT and Cambridge University Hospitals NHS FT will share an electronic patient record, extending CUH's Epic system (in use since 2014, HIMSS EMRAM Stage 7) to Royal Papworth through an Epic Connect model. The two trusts are neighbours on the Cambridge Biomedical Campus.

items.title: Acurable named in TIME magazine's World's Top HealthTech Companies of 2026
items.summary: UK medical device company Acurable, maker of AcuPebble, is one of only two UK Medical Devices and Wearables companies named in TIME magazine's World's Top HealthTech Companies of 2026 list.

items.title: Launching the HTNX experience: participation, discussion, opportunity
items.summary: HTN is delighted to launch HTNX, an event to discuss, participate, challenge and focus on emerging technologies, AI, automation, innovation, data, and future tech for health and care executives leading the future. At a p

items.title: AI task force established for Liverpool City region
items.summary: An AI Task Force has been established for the Liverpool City region, bringing together senior leaders from across industry, academia, healthcare, and public services to lead on ambitions for AI research, health innovatio

items.title: Applications open for Grow Digital Health Midlands Enabling Fund
items.summary: Applications have opened for the Grow Digital Health Midlands Enabling Fund, delivered by Health Innovation East Midlands and Health Innovation West Midlands, offering awards of up to £20,000 for digital health solutions

items.title: Barts Health NHS Trust looks to procure fertility EPR
items.summary: Barts Health NHS Trust is looking to procure a fertility EPR system with a total estimated value of £350,000. The system to support its fertility clinics will be awarded based on criteria including quality (60 percent we

items.title: GMC working on new ‘principles’ for doctors’ use of AI
items.summary: Regulators including the GMC and Professional Standards Authority (PSA) have committed to creating ‘high-level principles’ for regulating AI in healthcare in the UK.

items.title: GP practices ask to withdraw from ICB patient data sharing due to Palantir links
items.summary: Exclusive A group of GP practices signed up to share patient data with an ICB population management tool have asked to withdraw due to the tool’s links with the US tech company Palantir, according to their LMC.

items.title: GPs still impacted by ‘catastrophic’ trust IT glitch over one month later
items.summary: GP practices in Cornwall continue to feel the impact of trust IT glitch – which forced them to go through hundreds of duplicate test results per patient – over a month after the fault happened.

items.title: Calderdale and Huddersfield launches EPR inequalities prompt
items.summary: Calderdale and Huddersfield NHS Foundation Trust is set to launch an EPR inequalities flag to help colleagues across the trust identify patients at the greatest risk of experiencing health inequalities. The flag has been

items.title: Trusts to “move away” from group structure following organisational review of Humber Health Partnership
items.summary: A decision has been made for Hull University Teaching Hospitals NHS Trust (HUTH) and Northern Lincolnshire and Goole NHS Foundation Trust (NLAG) to “move away” from their current group structure, following an organisatio

items.title: Patients warned against lengthy AI-generated complaints to GP practices
items.summary: An LMC has created a letter for GPs to warn patients about using AI to write complaint letters, urging them to ‘use your own words’ wherever possible.

items.title: East Midlands Ambulance Service signs EPR contract
items.summary: East Midlands Ambulance Service NHS Trust has shared the latest on its new EPR, confirming a contract has been signed with provider Terrafix to replace its current system over the next year. The contract with its current

items.summary: Cambridge University Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust has outlined five priority transformation programmes to progress in 2026/27, covering digitally enabled flow, ambient voice technology, booking optimisation, and pathwa

items.title: Barking, Havering and Redbridge University Hospitals highlights pressing requirement for maternity EPR
items.summary: Barking, Havering and Redbridge University Hospitals NHS Trust has highlighted a “pressing requirement for a maternity EPR”, following the publication of the Amos report earlier this year. Investment for the new system w

items.title: GPs should receive ‘mandatory training’ on AI tools, MHRA recommends
items.summary: GPs should receive ‘mandatory training’ on how to use AI products in the future, the national commission into the regulation of AI in healthcare has recommended.

items.title: NHS doctor-led commission issues blueprint for AI's safe adoption in healthcare
items.summary: The MHRA-established National Commission into the Regulation of AI in Healthcare, chaired by NHS clinicians, published its recommendations on 10 September 2026 for keeping AI in UK healthcare safe while keeping pace with innovation.

items.title: Health tech round-up: August 2026
items.summary: Building Better Healthcare's August round-up covers expanded regulatory clearance for Flok Health's AI physiotherapy service among other UK health-tech announcements.

items.title: DAUK launches campaign urging Government to cut NHS ties with Palantir
items.summary: The Doctors’ Association UK (DAUK) has co-launched a new campaign urging the Government to cease US tech company Palantir’s involvement in the NHS.
